name: Having an Average Weekend
artist: Shadowy Men on a Shadowy Planet

artist_ref.name: Shadowy Men On A Shadowy Planet

podcast.body: This song is the proper name for what is widely recognized as the theme song for "The Kids in the Hall" TV show. "You might know that as the theme song to The Kids in the Hall TV show, but its proper name is Having an Average Weekend."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This surf music track was famously used as a TV theme song by The Kids in the Hall. Despite its surfy sound, the band initially resisted the surf music label. "The surf music track used by the kids in the hall for a TV theme."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Surprising History of Surf Music
